items.title: How iFood scales coding agents across 15,000 repositories

summaries.zh: iFood通过在15,000个代码库中扩展编码代理，实现了规模化开发。该策略提高了开发效率，优化了代码质量，并促进了团队协作。通过自动化工具和集中管理，iFood成功应对了大规模项目的挑战，确保了稳定运行。
summaries.en: iFood scaled its coding agents across 15,000 repositories using a modular architecture and automation. The process involved standardizing workflows, integrating AI tools, and optimizing infrastructure to handle large-scale operations. Key steps included containerization, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and monitoring systems. The initiative improved efficiency, reduced manual effort, and enabled rapid deployment across diverse repositories. By leveraging these technologies, iFood achieved scalable and maintainable code management for its extensive repository network.
